cloud_model_name.description: Cloud model for ONLY_IN_CLOUD analysis of the human-approved, sanitized payload. Allowed: gemini-3.5-flash-lite, gemini-3.8-flash, gemini-4-hydrogen. Anything else is rejected client-side.

playbook_id.description: Risk playbook. Allowed: COMMERCIAL_MSA_CONTRADICTION, NDA_CARVEOUT_AUDIT, DPA_SUBPROCESSOR_REVIEW. Unknown values fall back to the default.

max_cloud_output_tokens.description: Max output tokens for the cloud call. Clamped client-side to 256..4096.
